name: jpai-delivery
description: Delivery planning from jpeak.ai: gap-analysis planning that iteratively refines a tiered spec covering execution plan, gaps, decisions, and success and negative measures (plan-gap), paired with single-question decision consolidation that self-answers from existing decision records before asking (concise-decisions).
